title: Deploying to Vercel
description: The easiest way to deploy: connect your GitHub repo and go live in seconds with custom domains and env vars.

slides.title: Vercel: The Home of Next.js 🏠
slides.content:
# Zero‑Config Deployments

[Vercel](https://vercel.com) is the company behind Next.js. It provides:

* Automatic Git integration (push to main = deploy).
* Preview deployments for every PR.
* Serverless functions for API routes.
* Edge Network for global low latency.
* Environment variable management.

You can deploy a Next.js app in under a minute without any configuration.

slides.title: Step‑by‑Step 🚶
slides.content:
# Deploy from GitHub

1. Push your project to a GitHub repo.
2. Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com), sign up with GitHub.
3. Click **New Project**, import your repo.
4. Vercel detects Next.js; no settings needed.
5. Add environment variables (same as `.env.local`).
6. Click **Deploy**.

That's it. Your site is live on a `your-project.vercel.app` domain.

quizData.question: How does Vercel handle environment variables?

options.text: You add them in the project settings dashboard
It automatically uses the ones from your local machine

quizData.explanation: You set environment variables in the Vercel dashboard (Project Settings → Environment Variables). They are injected at build and runtime.

slides.title: Custom Domains & SSL 🔒
slides.content:
# Make It Yours

* In your project dashboard, go to **Settings → Domains**.
* Add your custom domain (e.g., `myapp.com`).
* Vercel automatically provisions and renews SSL certificates.
* You can also use subdomains.

Everything is HTTPS by default. No server configuration needed.

slides.content: Trigger a deploy from an external CI service using Deploy Hooks.

quizData.question: What is the default behavior for SSL on Vercel deployments?

options.text: You must manually upload a certificate
SSL is automatically provisioned and renewed for all domains
SSL is not available on the free plan

quizData.explanation: Vercel uses Let's Encrypt to automatically provide SSL certificates for both the generated subdomain and custom domains.

slides.title: Analytics & Monitoring 📈
slides.content:
# Vercel Dashboard Perks

* **Analytics**: Real‑time visitor stats, Core Web Vitals, page performance.
* **Logs**: View serverless function logs, build errors, runtime errors.
* **Deployment Protection**: Password protect preview deployments.

These tools help you monitor your app in production without additional setup.

slides.title: Best Practice ✨
slides.content: Use the **Vercel GitHub integration** to automatically create preview deployments for every pull request. Each PR gets a unique URL, making review and QA seamless.
